HOME.DESCRIPTION: I'm a Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience building scalable, efficient and accessible web applications. I thrive in collaborative coding environments and I'm constantly working to improve both my technical and interpersonal skills.

PROJECT.DEVUNITED: A Twitter-like website that uses Firebase as the Back End and React as the Front End. It was created as a final evaluated project for the Acamica course.
PROJECT.APIBRAIN: The Back End for the Brainstorming website, built with Node, Express and MongoDB. After finishing the Lamansys bootcamp and presenting Brainstorming, I built this API to replace the one they gave me for the final project.
PROJECT.PORTFOLIO: The site you are currently on, built with Angular, TypeScript, Angular Material, i18n and GSAP. Visit the GitHub repository to see how it works!
PROJECT.GIFY: A SPA that uses the external Giphy API (https://giphy.com/) and allows users to search for GIFs through a search bar. It was created as an evaluated project for the third sprint of the Acamica course.
PROJECT.BRAIN: A Scrum manager built as the final project for the Lamansys bootcamp using Angular and Angular Material, connected to an API provided by them for the evaluated project.
PROJECT.RM: A landing page built with Angular, TypeScript and Angular Material for a client who runs a naval mechanics workshop.
PROJECT.APICHAT: The Back End for the Chat App site, built with Socket.io, Express and MongoDB. After finishing a technical interview process and presenting ChatApp, I built this API to replace the one I was given for the challenge.
PROJECT.CHAT: A real-time chat app built with React and Socket.io that communicates with Api-chat.
PROJECT.PAWSOME: A mock e-commerce built with Next.js and Tailwind, running without a traditional back-end using Firebase and the Mercado Pago API. I also developed the admin panel to manage products, services, promotions and orders. Register and Login are functional, but the user panel is still in development.

ACTUALIDAD.TITLE: Now
ACTUALIDAD.STORY: From November 2025 to June 2026 I worked as a Front End Developer at Smarterix, a digital consultancy based in Mar del Plata, Argentina, in a hybrid work model. I participated in the full product lifecycle, from planning and implementation to maintenance and continuous improvement. My role included developing and maintaining modern interfaces using technologies such as PHP, Laravel and React, as well as integrating third-party services and APIs like Spatie and Google Drive API. I worked collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams to deliver scalable, maintainable digital solutions aligned with business objectives.

SWAPLYAR.TITLE: SwaplyAr
SWAPLYAR.STORY: I collaborated on Front End features using Next.js and Tailwind, improving and adding functionality focused on logic and information management algorithms. I helped the Back End team use Nest.js to fix bugs related to the features I was working on in the Front. Worked collaboratively with a multicultural Latin American team on feature implementation and bug fixing across the public, internal and administration sections. Tech stack: Next.js, Nest.js, Tailwind, Zustand and PostgreSQL.
